notes:
Account snapshot: mid-market B2B SaaS (workflow automation). Evaluating Hosted API first — quick PoC last quarter showed functional fit for in‑app assistant and doc search. Now pushing to Dedicated for predictable latency/cost and VPC requirement.

Key quotes: "We need predictable tail latency under 200ms for interactive flows" — Head of Product. "Budget conscious but will pay for reliability and residency guarantees" — VP Eng.

Security & compliance: SOC2 + SSO mandatory, want KMS integration and audit logs forwarded to Splunk. Data residency: primary in US, EU read-replicas for EU customers (legal redline).

POC ask (what they want to validate):
- Canary rollout of Dedicated: start with 5% traffic to dedicated pool, 25% after 48h if SLOs ok, then gradual ramp to 100%
- Fallback routing: Hosted API fallback for cold starts and overflow, model-variant fallback (quantized cheaper variant if high load), region failover EU <-> US for outage scenarios
- Rollback plan: immediate traffic cut to Hosted + automated circuit-breaker if 5xx rate > 1% or p95 latency > 350ms for 30m
- Metrics to collect: p50/p95 latency, token cost per 1k, error rates, cold-starts, KV cache hit-rate, request origin region

Cost targets: want < $0.60 per 1k prompt+completion tokens for baseline embeddings/generation workload; acceptable to pay premium for 99.9% SLA during business hours.

Technical notes from SE call (Priya) 2026-02-18:
- Model preferences: prefer open models but open to Redwood-verified variants; interested in 8-bit quantized variant for cost-sensitive routes.
- Throughput/latency: steady QPS 30-50 during peak; latency SLO interactive <200ms, background jobs can be up to 1s.
- Integration: VPC peering required, system will use internal auth and SSO (SAML). Want examples of canary + rollback policies in Console (request: sample configs).

Sales actions to date:
- 2026-01-28: inbound sign-up, quick api keys issued for hosted PoC (Jordan).
- 2026-02-09: hosted PoC demo — internal app integrated search + summarization (recorded, Fireflies id above).
- 2026-02-18: SE deep dive (Priya) — walked canary/fallback design options, discussed quantized model variants.
- 2026-02-25: Security questionnaire sent; CS team flagged two legal redlines around EU residency.
- 2026-03-02: Pricing dry-run with finance; procurement requested committed spend tiers for Dedicated.
- 2026-03-09: Contracting intake call — procurement placed budget hold pending legal OK.

Next steps (short):
- Deliver Dedicated POC plan + sample canary JSON and routing policy by 2026-03-12 (action: SE).
- Schedule VPC peering window with infra (ambercliff infra) for week of 2026-03-17.
- Legal: provide residency clause language and KMS integration note (action: security team).

Risks / objections:
- Procurement wants fixed monthly commitment; product team wants flexibility. Need to propose burst/baseline combo.
- Legal insists on EU data not leaving jurisdiction for certain customers — may require regional Dedicated pools / isolated model variants.
- They have an internal SLO of <200ms p95; we need to show Dedicated meeting tail latency under realistic traffic during POC.

Sales play: recommend 12-mo Reserved Dedicated with optional burst credits + trial month. Emphasize canary/fallback and observability (per-route token breakdown) to de-risk migration.

use_case_summary: Primary: in-app AI assistant that surfaces contextual docs and produces short summaries for workflows. Must be low-latency interactive; embeddings used for retrieval. Secondary: scheduled batch summarization of long transcripts.
poc_plan: 3-week Dedicated POC: Week 1 — provision Dedicated pool in us-east and eu-west, VPC peering, baseline traffic mirrored from hosted; Week 2 — canary: 5% traffic to Dedicated, run synthetic load + smoke tests, collect latency/cost metrics; Week 3 — ramp to 25-50% depending on SLOs, validate fallback to Hosted and quantized model variant under induced load; final review and decision meeting.
canary_and_fallback_details: Canary percentages: 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 48-72h windows; fallback chains: primary model (redwood-verified-highperf) -> quantized variant (redwood-quant-8bit) -> hosted_api_fallback; region failover: us-east primary, eu-west replica; circuit-breaker triggers: 5xx >1% OR p95 latency >350ms for 30m; automatic rollback policy documented in sample config.
technical_requirements: VPC peering + static egress IPs, SAML SSO integration, KMS customer-managed key, audit log forwarding, ability to pin model versions, per-route observability and tracing, request-level routing policies (cost vs latency).
pricing_notes: Procurement asking for 12-mo commitment tiers: $75k (base) to $250k (high) ARR bands. Request for burst credits and clear overage pricing. Ask finance to provide an example TCO comparing Hosted vs Dedicated at projected QPS.
internal_recommendation: Offer 1-month pilot Dedicated with 50% discounted commit, include canary+rollback config templates, and provide a tracked SLA for business-hours 99.9%. Prepare a narrow legal/data residency addendum for EU customers.
customer_sentiment: cautiously optimistic — technical fit is good, main friction is legal + procurement. Product team enthusiastic about tail latency improvements.
